about: Which Kyr definitions represent each Orsino registry entry, and how far. support: represented (typed Kyr equivalent, some mechanics omitted), executable (every source mechanic runs through canonical Kyr systems or has a declared adaptation), play-validated (exercised in real play; evidence is file#text that must appear in that file). Every feature Kyr judges unsupported must be listed under omits or adapts. Checked by test/orsino-registry.test.ts.

records.note: The red colour's fire_breath replaces the bite, as the template's overlay does. Its description is the kind's description.

Exact 4d6 fire. Orsino fires it at one target through melee with an attack roll and no save. Kyr breathes it over every opponent with one shared roll, a breath-category save (Orsino's Constitution-based category, its modifiers and immunity) against 15 + the dragon's level (Orsino's default debuff difficulty) for half, and a three-turn recharge. Fire released this way exposes the place to fire.

A species' natural weapon: its melee attack rolls THAC0 against armour class and deals the weapon die plus the positive STR modifier. No longer exercised in recorded play: the re-recorded fire history ends before the dragon bites.
